_why._: Why each source is copied rather than pointed at. A pointer into another skill folder would resolve in this repo and in the plugin install, which ships all of skills/, but `npx skills add izentenosmith/skills --skill <name>` and a hand copy install one skill folder alone, and the installer drops any symlink that leaves it. Every copy is read by its own skill (its SKILL.md, a script, or another copy beside it) and every consuming skill installs on its own, so every copy stays. Reviewed 2026-11-24: none could become a pointer.
_why.skills/database/dbaudit/detection-signal: dbquery's SKILL.md and scoring.md read it, and dbquery installs without dbaudit.
_why.skills/database/dbaudit/er-modeling.md: Six database skills read it from SKILL.md and from their theory.md copy; each installs alone.
_why.skills/database/dbaudit/scoring.md: dbquery scores on the same rubric and installs without dbaudit.
_why.skills/database/dbaudit/theory.md: The relational-theory reference six database skills cite; each installs alone.
_why.skills/database/dbdesign/physical-design: dbbuild and dbpropose read it and install without dbdesign.
netdesign reads it, and the theory.md and topology-modeling.md copies link it in netblueprint and netpropose; each installs alone.
_why.skills/networking/netaudit/scripts/netgr: A script each networking skill runs from its own scripts/ folder; a single-skill install has no sibling folder to run it from.
_why.skills/networking/netaudit/theory.md: netdesign, netpropose and netblueprint cite it, directly or through other copies; each installs alone.
_why.skills/networking/netaudit/topology-mode: The model netgraph.py reads; every skill that carries the script carries this.
_why.skills/networking/netdesign/design-patte: netpropose reads it and installs without netdesign.
_why.skills/networking/netdiagram/diagram-con: netblueprint and netpropose read it (and their netgraph.py copy names it); both install without netdiagram.
_why.skills/operations/hotfix/diagnosis.md: incident-fix reads it and installs without hotfix.
_why.skills/development/architect-deep-dive/p: What every pipeline stage shares; any stage installs alone (the Trivial tier runs tdd and refactor-review only).
_why.harness/LEDGER.md: The source is in harness/, which no install path ships (the plugins are ./skills alone); the stages that write a ledger need its grammar in their own folder.
_why.harness/ledger.py: A checker each ledger-writing stage runs on its own output; harness/ is never installed.
_why.harness/redgreen.py: A checker acceptance-tests and tdd run; harness/ is never installed.
_why.harness/brief.py: A checker the brief-reading stages run; harness/ is never installed.
_why.skills/database/dbpropose/proposal.md: dbbuild reads the proposal format it builds from and installs without dbpropose.
